tasks.title: Fix: Run disabled while a run is in progress
tasks.description: Corrective for phase 5 (task 33 reviewer finding, parked by mistake). On LessonPage, Run stays enabled during a run, so a second Run clobbers the running flag and Stop gets disabled mid-run. Disable Run (and Submit) while running; Stop stays enabled until the run ends, errors, times out or is stopped.
